description: Ask the person for an API key without it passing through this chat. Returns a one-time link to the Shipvo vault page (valid 10 minutes, works once) and a notice to show the person. The key goes straight into the vault: you never see it. Tell the person to open the link, then call secret_status to learn whether it was saved. Needs an owner token.

access.description: Access the key should have (default read)

name.description: Name for the key, e.g. STRIPE_KEY (letters, digits and underscores)

purpose.description: Why the app needs it, in plain English; shown to the person on the vault page

name: request_secret
